reads.name: Puka Nacua
reads.body: No injury designation for Puka Nacua on the latest report, so he's a full go for Sunday's 3:05 pm Central kickoff against Arizona at home, indoors under a fixed roof. He's coming off 37.7 PPR points against Buffalo in week 5 of 2026 and sits at 25.9 PPR points a game this season. The Cardinals rank 28th of 32 against receivers, giving up 40.3 PPR points a game through week 5 of 2026, and the expected score has the Rams at 32 to Arizona's 19.5. The published projection for week 6 of 2026 is 23 points in PPR scoring. He's first among Rams receivers with Davante Adams second, and we have him WR1 overall on our board, so start him.

reads.body: Detroit doesn't play in week 6 of 2026, so Jahmyr Gibbs sits this week and scores you nothing while the Lions are on their bye. reads.name: CeeDee Lamb
reads.body: He's questionable on the latest report, so his status for week 6 of 2026 at Green Bay isn't settled until you check the inactives before the 7:20 pm Central kickoff Sunday.
